captions.text: The question is the crop's water needs.
Texas Tech and AgriLife are planning trials under different irrigation conditions.
The buried lines would control trial water.
The team would use drones, ground sensors and satellite imagery.
Those observations would enter one database.
Machine learning would predict crop growth under different irrigation conditions.
The goal is irrigation recommendations for growers.
Trials are planned on research land.

retime_evidence._why: A cut is placed at the start of the line its scene carries. That word's time is measured when the reader paused before it and modelled by syllable weight when they did not, so this counts both rather than claiming all are measured.
